rows.note: Use this when something is done in a nonsensical or absurd way; it is the all-purpose spoken choice for that.

example.english: They spoke so meaninglessly that I couldn't understand them at all.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢講到無厘頭咁，我完全聽唔明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dou3 mou4 lei4 tau4 gam3 ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that an action has no purpose or significance rather than that it is absurd.

example.english: I don't want to waste time meaninglessly.
example.traditional: 我唔想冇意義咁浪費時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 mou5 ji3 ji6 gam3 long6 fai3 si4 gaan1
